scripts.start: cargo build --manifest-path core/Cargo.toml && npm start -w apps/desktop
scripts.test: cargo test --manifest-path core/Cargo.toml && npm test -w apps/desktop
scripts.dist: cargo build --release --manifest-path core/Cargo.toml && npm run dist -w apps/desktop
scripts.test:windows: scripts/windows.sh cargo test --manifest-path core/Cargo.toml && scripts/windows.sh node --test "apps/desktop/test/**/*.test.js"
scripts.bench: cargo build --release --manifest-path core/Cargo.toml && npm run bench -w apps/desktop
scripts.bench:windows: scripts/windows.sh cargo build --release --manifest-path core/Cargo.toml && scripts/windows.sh node apps/desktop/scripts/bench.js
